issues.description: Forbidden template placeholder: url = ""  # CI fills this. Code-style Rule 5 explicitly prohibits this pattern in merged code — the recipe URL should be filled by the adapter, not left empty with a 'CI fills this' comment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the url field to the actual recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/<org>/<repo>/-/tree/main/archives/s/samurai/1.3" or the appropriate recipe hosting URL.

issues.description: conandata.yml manually lists 6 mirror-prefixed URLs (gh-proxy.com, mirror.ghproxy.com, ghproxy.com, gitclone.com, moeyy.cn, kkgithub.com) before the official GitHub URL. R39 states: 'CI will automatically add mirror fallbacks for GitHub URLs, so conandata.yml should only contain the official original URL — do not manually add mirror prefixes.' This causes redundant mirror URLs and potential duplicate fallbacks when CI also adds them.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the url list with a single official URL: url: "https://github.com/michaelforney/samurai/archive/refs/tags/1.3.tar.gz". CI will automatically handle mirror fallbacks.

issues.description: notes.md is essentially an unfilled template. Contains multiple unresolved placeholders: {cmake|autotools|makefile|meson|custom}, {2026-07-15}, {published|built|failed}, {用文字描述实际编译步骤...}, {按需添加行}, {如有补丁...}, {列出本次编译依赖...}, {验证命令和结果}, {有打包产物时添加...}, {需要特别注意的点...}. The template was never filled in with actual adaptation details. Additionally, the bottom states '**最终状态**: built' which contradicts manifest.yaml's 'status: published'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Fill in all template placeholders with actual adaptation information: build system (makefile), compiler (clang), actual build steps, problems encountered (none for 1.3), verification commands, and ensure the status field matches manifest.yaml ('published').

issues.description: Shell script uses 'set -eu' but is missing '-o pipefail'. Code-style Rule 7 requires all scripts to start with 'set -euo pipefail' for safe mode. While this script has no pipes currently, the rule is mandatory for all shell scripts.

Shebang uses '#!/data/service/hnp/bin/bash' instead of the standard '#!/usr/bin/zsh' specified by code-style Rule 6. While the OHOS-specific path is pragmatic, the script is invoked via 'bash test.sh' in test_package/conanfile.py so the shebang is not actually used at runtime, but it should still follow the coding standard.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change shebang to '#!/usr/bin/zsh' to comply with code-style Rule 6. Since the script is invoked via 'bash test.sh', the shebang is not used at runtime and this change is safe.

issues.description: Package-level manifest key_points states '需要 Makefile 和 configure 补丁适配' (needs Makefile and configure patches), but this contradicts: (1) conandata.yml has patches: {} (no patches), (2) version-level manifest states 'samurai 1.3 builds cleanly on OHOS with no patches needed', (3) samurai has no configure script (it is a plain POSIX Makefile project). This key_points entry appears to be stale from version 1.2 and was not updated for 1.3.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update key_points to reflect that samurai 1.3 builds cleanly on OHOS with no patches needed, e.g. key_points: ['No patches needed for 1.3 (improved from 1.2)', 'POSIX Makefile project, uses CC/CFLAGS/LDLIBS env vars'].

issues.description: test_package/conanfile.py is missing the shebang and file-level docstring header. Code-style Rule 1 requires conanfile.py files to have '#!/usr/bin/env python3' shebang and a docstring describing the software and build system.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line and a module-level docstring such as '"""test_package for samurai 1.3 — smoke test for samu executable."""' before the import statements.

issues.description: Output format uses '[test]' prefix instead of the standard '[step]'/'[ok]'/'[fail]'/'[warn]' format specified by code-style Rule 9. The '[ok]'/'[fail]' markers should also be indented with 8 spaces for alignment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use '[step]' for the initial step marker, and '[ok]'/'[fail]' with 8-space indent for results, e.g.: echo "[step] Checking samu --version..." then echo "        [ok] samu --version succeeded".

issues.description: upstream_check_command is set to 'make check' but lines 11-12 explicitly state 'samurai has no make check target — no upstream test suite' and upstream_test_in_build is false. This is contradictory — if there is no upstream test suite, upstream_check_command should be empty.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set upstream_check_command to "" (empty) to be consistent with upstream_test_in_build: false and the comment about no test suite.

issues.description: Uses AutotoolsToolchain for a plain POSIX Makefile project (no configure script). While AutotoolsToolchain correctly generates CC/CFLAGS/LDFLAGS env vars that the Makefile respects, the semantic mismatch could be confusing. A more appropriate toolchain class (if available) or explicit documentation of why AutotoolsToolchain is used would be clearer.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using a more semantically appropriate approach, or add a comment explaining that AutotoolsToolchain is used purely for env var generation (CC, CFLAGS, LDFLAGS) since the Makefile reads these from the environment.

issues.description: Test only checks 'samu --version' (and falls back to 'samu --help'). While this satisfies R34's minimum requirement of executing the binary, it does not test samurai's actual build functionality. A more thorough test would create a simple build.ninja file and invoke 'samu' to build it, verifying the tool's core functionality.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a functional test: create a minimal build.ninja file and run 'samu' to execute a simple build, verifying that samu can actually parse and execute build rules, not just report its version.

summary: Audit of samurai 1.3 Conan recipe (feat/samurai-1.3 branch). VERDICT: PASS (no P0 or P1 issues). Deception detection (P0) passed: test_package actually executes the samu binary via test.sh (R34 satisfied), no fake sha256, no fake status, no stub tests, no pre-compiled binaries. Recipe correctness (P1) passed: no hardcoded compiler values, no settings.os == 'Linux' issues (R32 OK), version 1.3 matches upstream, no platform compatibility issues, R33 satisfied (uses AutotoolsToolchain, no bare shell env vars in build commands). 7 P2 code-style issues found: (1) forbidden 'url = ""  # CI fills this' placeholder in conanfile.py, (2) conandata.yml manually lists mirror URLs instead of official-only URL per R39, (3) notes.md is completely unfilled template, (4) test.sh missing 'set -o pipefail', (5) test.sh shebang not '#!/usr/bin/zsh', (6) package-level manifest key_points contradicts actual no-patches state, (7) test_package/conanfile.py missing shebang/docstring. 4 P3 suggestions for improvement. The recipe is functionally sound but has style and documentation completeness issues that should be addressed before merge.
